title: gnaphalium microcephalum var. thermale
intro: Gnaphalium microcephalum var. thermale, commonly known as Hot Springs Cudweed, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Hot Springs Cudweed include its ability to reduce swelling, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
